from scipy.interpolate import BSpline
def basis(x,k=12):
    x=(x-x.min())/(x.max()-x.min())
    kn=np.r_[[0]*3,np.quantile(x,np.linspace(0,1,k-2)),[1]*3]
    return np.array([BSpline(kn,np.eye(k)[i],3,extrapolate=True)(x) for i in range(k)]).T
def test(us,name):
    B=np.hstack([basis(u) for u in us]+[np.ones((len(t),1))])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dA_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print(name, np.mean((B@c-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt))
test([t,A],'t,A')
for p in [-2,-1,-.5,.5,1,1.5,2,3]:
    test([t,A,t*A**p],'t*A^%g'%p)
    test([t,A,np.log(t*A**p)],'log t*A^%g'%p)
for c in [-2,-1,-.5,.5,1,2]:
